Troubleshooting
What is Sage Garden?
Sage Garden keeps track of every plant in your garden — where it is, how to look after it, and when it next needs water, food or pruning. It\'s free, with no ads.
What does the Home tab show?

What needs doing today in the garden you\'re viewing — plants to water, fertilise, feed or prune, and zones due a progress photo — with a button to log each one as done. Below that is an overview of your garden.
How do I add a plant?

Tap + on the Plants tab, or tap an empty spot on the Map. Only the name is required — everything else can be added later. Tip: add a photo and tap \"Suggest name from photo\" to fill in the name for you.
What\'s the difference between Basic and Advanced mode?

Basic shows the essentials: your plants, watering reminders, photos, the home-screen widget and backups. Advanced adds everything else, such as your own garden map, the sun map, irrigation controllers, weather and frost alerts, feeding and pruning schedules, and garden sharing. Switch at any time — nothing you\'ve entered is lost.
Why should I set my garden\'s address?
It centres the map on your garden, tells the app which hemisphere you\'re in (for summer and winter watering), and lets weather and frost alerts use your local forecast.
How do I find a plant?
Use the search bar on the Plants tab. It matches plant name, scientific name, zone, plant ID, sun, water, soil, category, frost tolerance, source and more — but not notes.
What are plant IDs (P0001, Q0001…)?
A short code for each plant, handy for garden labels and spreadsheets. Your own garden uses P, and each extra garden you create gets its own letter so IDs never clash.
What are garden zones?
Named areas such as \"Front bed\" or \"Veggie patch\". Plants are grouped by zone on the Plants tab, and progress photos are taken per zone. The garden\'s owner manages the list.
How does identifying a plant from a photo work?
Add a clear photo of a leaf or flower and tap \"Suggest name from photo\". The photo is sent to Pl@ntNet, which suggests the most likely species. You can identify up to %1$d plants a day.
What do the Sage suggestions on a plant do?

Once a plant has a scientific name, Sage can suggest its sun, water, soil and frost needs and how often to water, fertilise, feed and prune it. Check the suggestions against your own conditions before saving.
How do I delete a plant?
Open the plant and tap Delete at the bottom. In a shared garden this removes it for everyone, and it can\'t be undone.
What is Garden check?

A quick health check, at the top of the Plants tab. It lists plants with no photo, map location or watering schedule, overdue care, frost-tender plants outdoors, and plants sitting next to neighbours with very different sun needs.
Can I use my own garden plan instead of the satellite map?
Yes. Upload a drawing or photo of your garden as your own map, then place plants on it. You can switch between it and the satellite map on the Map tab.
How do I place or move a plant on the map?
Open the plant, tap the map placement button, then tap where it grows.
Why does the map open where it does?
The map reopens wherever you last left it. A new garden starts at its address, so set that first.
What is the sun map?
Mark the areas of your garden that get full sun, part shade or shade. Garden check then flags plants whose sun needs don\'t match where they\'re planted.
How does the app know when a plant needs water?
From when it was last watered and how often it needs it (every so many days). Logging watering — from Home, the plant, a reminder, or your irrigation controller — resets the clock.
How do I turn on reminders?
Go to Settings → Reminders, switch reminders on for this garden and pick a time. Allow notifications when Android asks.
Can each garden have its own reminder time?
No. There\'s one daily check at the time you choose, covering all your gardens, so you get one tidy notification per task. Which reminders you get is set per garden.
My reminders aren\'t arriving. What should I check?

Make sure notifications are allowed for Sage Garden and, on Android 12 or later, that \"Alarms & reminders\" is allowed. Some phones put apps to sleep to save battery — set Sage Garden\'s battery use to Unrestricted in Android\'s app settings.
Why did I get the same reminder again?
If a task stays overdue you\'re reminded again every few days (every 3 days unless you change it) until it\'s logged. Change the gap or turn it off in Settings → Reminders.
Can a plant need more water in summer?

Yes — set separate summer and winter watering frequencies on the plant. Summer is December to February in the Southern Hemisphere and June to August in the Northern; other months use the plant\'s normal frequency. Your hemisphere comes from the garden\'s address.
How do fertilising, feeding and pruning reminders work?
Set how often each plant needs it on the plant\'s page, then switch that reminder on in Settings → Reminders.
What are weather-aware reminders?

If real rain is forecast, your watering reminder says so, so you can skip watering. By default that means at least a 60 per cent chance and 1 mm of rain; you can change both. Needs the garden\'s address.
How do frost warnings work?
When the overnight forecast drops to 2 °C or lower (you can change this), you\'re warned to protect frost-tender and half-hardy plants that aren\'t marked as indoor. Needs the garden\'s address.
What are progress-photo reminders?

Every three months you\'re prompted to photograph each zone, so you can see how it\'s growing over time. You\'re reminded once when a zone becomes due, then again on your overdue-repeat schedule until you add a photo.
Which irrigation controllers work with Sage Garden?
Tuya-based smart taps and valves (sold under many brands, and used by the Smart Life app) and Rachio controllers. Sage Garden only reads watering history — it never turns water on or off.
How do I connect a Tuya controller?

Create a free Cloud project on the Tuya IoT Platform and link your Smart Life account to it. Then enter the project\'s Client ID and Secret in Settings → Irrigation, and add each zone\'s device ID and outlet.
How do I connect a Rachio controller?
Copy your API key from the Rachio app (Profile → API key), paste it into Settings → Irrigation, then add your zones.
How does watering history get into the app?

Sage Garden pulls the last 30 days from your controller automatically every 5 days — Tuya only keeps about a week — and you can tap \"Sync watering history\" any time. Sessions appear on the Water tab and are saved to irrigation_log.csv.
How are water use and cost estimated?
Enter each zone\'s flow rate (litres per minute) and your water price per kilolitre. Sage Garden multiplies these by how long each zone ran. It\'s an estimate, so compare it with your water bill.
What is \"My watering schedule\"?
A reference list of which days and times each zone runs — useful for timers Sage Garden can\'t read. It doesn\'t control anything.
Where are my photos stored?

On your phone by default, which means they won\'t move to a new phone and are lost if the app is uninstalled. Connect Dropbox to save new photos to your own Dropbox instead. Keeping photos under 1 MB saves space.
What is a growth timeline?
Dated photos of one plant, so you can see how it\'s grown. Open the plant and tap Growth timeline.
What are extra photos?
Anything else worth keeping with a plant — its nursery label, a care leaflet, or where its dripper is.
How do I share my garden?
Go to Settings → This garden and tap Share to get an invite code. The other person enters it under \"Join a garden\", then you approve their request and choose whether they can edit or only view.
How do I join someone else\'s garden?
Ask the owner for their invite code, go to Settings → This garden → Join a garden, and enter it. You\'ll get access once they approve.
How do I switch between gardens?
Tap the garden\'s name at the top of the screen and pick another.
What\'s the difference between \"can edit\" and \"view only\"?
Editors can add, change and delete plants and log care. View-only members see everything but can\'t change it. Only the owner can change the garden\'s address, zones and members.
What\'s shared, and what stays on my phone?

Shared with everyone in the garden: plants (with a small thumbnail of each plant\'s main photo), care history, the garden\'s address and zones, and the owner\'s garden map with its irrigation lines and sun zones. Kept on each phone: full-size photos, irrigation logins and history, and reminder settings.
How quickly do changes show up on other phones?
Within a few seconds while both apps are open, otherwise the next time the app is opened.
How do I leave a garden or remove someone?
In Settings → This garden: members can leave, and the owner can remove members or delete the garden entirely.
Can I use Sage Garden on a computer?
Yes, with the Sage Garden desktop app. Link it once by entering this phone\'s Install ID (Settings → About) into the desktop app.
How do I add the home-screen widget?
Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, and drag \"Plants requiring care\" onto it. You can choose which care types and gardens it shows and how often it refreshes.
The widget looks out of date.
It refreshes on the schedule you chose; tap its refresh button to update it now. Opening the app also updates it.
What can Sage help with?

Ask gardening questions — what to plant where, pests and diseases, pruning, and so on. Tap the leaf button on any screen. Sage doesn\'t see your garden unless you describe it, and can be wrong, so double-check anything important.
Are there any limits?
Everything in Sage Garden is free. Two features call paid AI services, so they\'re capped: Sage chat (%1$d free questions) and identifying plants from photos (%2$d a day).
How is my garden backed up?

Automatically: each day you open the app, a snapshot is saved on your phone (the last 7 days are kept), and to Dropbox too if it\'s connected. Manually: back up everything to Dropbox or a folder, or export your plants as a CSV spreadsheet.
How do I move to a new phone?

Back up to Dropbox on your old phone, then restore it on the new one from Settings → Backup & data. Gardens shared with you reappear once you re-join. Photos only come across if they\'re stored in Dropbox.
What format should my CSV files be in?

For plants, a header row with at least a \"Plant\" column; export a CSV first to see every column. For irrigation logs, the header needs Zone, StartTime and DurationMinutes (Outlet and Source are optional). Column order and capitals don\'t matter.
What does \"Reset garden\" do?
It deletes every plant in this garden — for everyone it\'s shared with. It can\'t be undone, so back up first.
Where is my data stored?

On your phone, and in Sage Garden\'s secure cloud (Google Firebase) so your gardens can sync between devices and be shared. The cloud copy holds your plants (with a small thumbnail of each main photo), care history, garden names, address, coordinates and zones, your uploaded garden map with its irrigation lines and sun zones, and who has access. Full-size photos stay on your phone or in your own Dropbox. Irrigation logins and reminder settings never leave your phone.
Who else receives any of my data?

Only what each feature needs: Google (maps and address search), Open-Meteo (your garden\'s coordinates, for weather and frost alerts), Pl@ntNet (a photo, when you identify a plant), Anthropic (your Sage questions and plant names for suggestions), and Dropbox, Tuya or Rachio only if you connect them. No ads, no tracking, and your data is never sold.
Do I need an account?
No. Sage Garden uses a random ID for your phone — no name, email or password.
How do I delete my data?

Delete plants or a whole garden in the app — deleting a garden you own removes it from the cloud for everyone. To have everything linked to your phone deleted, email us with your Install ID (Settings → About).
Changes aren\'t showing on another phone.
Check both phones are online and in the same garden (tap the name at the top to check). View-only members can\'t make changes. Opening the app on both phones syncs straight away.
Summer and winter watering seem the wrong way round.
The app works out your hemisphere from the garden\'s address. Check the address is correct, or choose your hemisphere manually if you haven\'t set one.
How do I report a problem or suggest an idea?
Email spokolabs@gmail.com from Settings → About — we read everything.
